scope: Metadata-only Chewy scene/pose intake; no media copy, generation, or canonical approval mutation.

policy.characterAssignment: Group brief intent or exact per-file provider note; not independent visual confirmation.
policy.approval: All new assets remain preliminary and not accepted; no inference from provider self-scores, cover choice, or current design grouping.
policy.providerScores: Preserved verbatim with source path and line; separate from human reviews and never promoted into human likeness/scene ratings.
policy.duplicates: 323 source files, 321 unique byte hashes. Same-byte C21 unsuffixed/v001 copies are aliases; distinct v002 revisions remain separate assets.
policy.motion: Still images only; no motion execution/validation implied.
policy.sourcePaths: Files remain under existing D:/Documents/CFA/docs/notes/downloads folders.
policy.viewSeparation: Supporting cast shows one representative and meaningful scenes/videos. Full design angles and animation/setup candidates belong in Working references. Setup is a reference role, not approval.

castCollectionMapping.workingReferenceAcceptance: No per-ID existing canonical approval established by this intake; root owns any newly authorized scoped decision.
